# Distinguish reviewed native molecular alternatives from product identity in candidate checks

The isolated #1241 candidate's real second-cycle export passed byte-for-byte,
but `consumer-review-02` failed its synonym assertion: the acceptance helper
requires all four explicit structural names to return CHEBI:86658. One exact
spelling selects CHEBI:196822 from an earlier, unchanged native-xref row.
Preserve this failed receipt; it is not completed consumer acceptance.

Independent extraction from pinned raw ChEBI
`a5d40380ab78bde0e8b5a704dbee3cba2bcaa7608be46eebc2f4a92932516c9b`
shows both IDs have identical full InChI, InChIKey, stereospecific SMILES,
formula and charge 0. The extractor retained their complete declarations and
incident assertions, not formula-only or lexical evidence. All 19 mapping rows
targeting CHEBI:196822 or CHEBI:16110 are unchanged from the baseline candidate.

Separately, generic L-alpha/L-alpha-symbol queries select CHEBI:16110 only with
synonyms enabled. This is an unchanged native related-synonym route to a +1
wildcard-R class, not exact structural identity or supplier P3556 identity.
The explicit P3556 source guard must continue retaining the original local
ingredient. No runtime precedence change, global identifier merge, new same_as
assertion, native synonym removal or new product grounding is authorized.

Fix the finite acceptance check: bind the retained native/full-row witnesses,
allow CHEBI:196822 only for the exact reviewed structural spelling, distinguish
the two reviewed generic lexical-class outcomes, and require review for any
new alternative. Preserve canonical-label, native alias availability, removed
MIM exact-xref, chloride, parent, Potato and unrelated positive controls.
Check actual final-candidate rows against the retained complete competing rows.
Test altered structures/charges, other spellings/targets, missing evidence,
changed candidate rows/multiplicity, and canonical-mode misuse. Run replacement
acceptance only in a new attempt after independent review; keep old helper and
failed receipts unchanged.

Evidence: `identity-candidate-1241.7Zc6Ur/reader-diagnostic-1247.ZQSqrf/`
`NATIVE-INTERPRETATION.md`; `native-alternative-authority.json` SHA-256
`1cee9914ee50e7e2b7af2598df14339943130ad26684117562bb0c2dfb6491e8`.
This is an external acceptance-helper defect, not proof of a new chemical
mapping regression. Final source replay and all-source KG acceptance remain pending.
title: Bind candidate reader controls to reviewed native molecular alternatives
